explanation: Diviners carved questions and answers onto them, the earliest large body of Chinese writing. Before scholars recognized them in 1899, many were sold as 'dragon bones' for medicine.

claims.text: Shang dynasty diviners applied heat to ox shoulder blades and turtle shells and read the cracks as answers from ancestors or gods.
Shang divination did not use heated bronze bowls, clay tablets or jade discs.
Shang oracle bone inscriptions are the earliest substantial body of Chinese writing.
Scholars recognized the inscriptions on oracle bones in 1899, when such bones were being sold as 'dragon bones' for traditional medicine.
